fichas.title: Indoor public pool configurations
fichas.summary: Reference sheet showing plans and sections for indoor public paddling, non-swimmers’, combined, swimmers’, and wave pools. The table gives pool widths and lengths, water-depth notes, and minimum ceiling heights; diagrams include a height-adjustable Variopool floor and wave-pool variants.
